_comment: Instance data for core helpers/question-gate.cjs: how a question to the operator (a proposal awaiting a yes/no or a choice) is phrased in this brain's language. English is built in. Regexes, case-insensitive; the sentence must also end in '?'. Example for German: \bsoll ich\b, \bwillst du\b, \bjetzt\b.*\boder\b.
